name: GitHub_search_repositories
description: Search GitHub public repositories with explicit page pagination and completeness metadata. Continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true. GitHub reports the full match count but exposes only the first 1,000 search results; metadata.retrieval_capped and warning make that hard limit explicit. Narrow broad queries to reach repositories outside that window. Rate limit: 10 requests/minute unauthenticated.

q.description: Search query with optional qualifiers. Examples: 'bioinformatics language:python stars:>100', 'protein structure prediction', 'topic:machine-learning language:python', 'alphafold protein', 'single cell RNA sequencing', 'user:deepmind'

page.description: One-based page within GitHub Search's first-1,000-result window. Continue with metadata.next_page.

events_url.description: GitHub API template for the account's events, e.g. with a '{/...}' placeholder in it. An RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE, not a URL - requesting it unexpanded returns 404.

node_id.description: The account's GraphQL node id, e.g. 'MDQ6VXNlcjEwMjQwMjU='. Required by the GraphQL API, where the numeric id is not accepted.

url.description: API URL for the account, e.g. 'https://api.github.com/users/torvalds'. The API address, not the html_url a person would open.

archive_url.description: GitHub API template for a source archive - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{archive_format}{/ref}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

archived.description: True when the repository is archived - read-only, no longer maintained. Nothing else in the record says the project is dead.

assignees_url.description: GitHub API template for assignable users - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/user}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

blobs_url.description: GitHub API template for a git blob - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/sha}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

branches_url.description: GitHub API template for a branch - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/branch}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

clone_url.description: HTTPS git clone URL for the repository. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

collaborators_url.description: GitHub API template for a collaborator - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/collaborator}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

comments_url.description: GitHub API template for a commit comment - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/number}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

commits_url.description: GitHub API template for a commit - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/sha}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

compare_url.description: GitHub API template for a comparison between two refs - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{base}...{head}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

contents_url.description: GitHub API template for a path in the tree - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{+path}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

contributors_url.description: API URL listing contributors. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

deployments_url.description: API URL listing deployments. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

disabled.description: True when GitHub has disabled the repository, e.g. for a terms violation. Its contents are not retrievable.

downloads_url.description: API URL listing downloads (a legacy endpoint). A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

fork.description: True when the repository is a fork. A fork's stars and issues belong to the fork, not to the upstream project.

forks.description: Fork count, e.g. 2963. The same number as forks_count; both are returned.

forks_url.description: API URL listing forks. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

git_commits_url.description: GitHub API template for a raw git commit - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/sha}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

git_refs_url.description: GitHub API template for a git ref - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/sha}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

git_tags_url.description: GitHub API template for a git tag - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/sha}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

git_url.description: git:// protocol URL, which carries no authentication. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

has_downloads.description: True when the legacy downloads feature is enabled.

has_issues.description: True when the issue tracker is enabled. open_issues is 0 for a repository with issues disabled, which is not the same as a repository with no open issues.

has_pages.description: True when GitHub Pages is enabled.

has_projects.description: True when project boards are enabled.

has_pull_requests.description: True when pull requests are accepted.

has_wiki.description: True when the wiki is enabled.

homepage.description: The project's own home page, e.g. 'https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00065'. Measured on 4 of 5 repositories - for a research repository this is usually the paper.

hooks_url.description: API URL listing webhooks. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

is_template.description: True when the repository is a template rather than a project.

issue_comment_url.description: GitHub API template for an issue comment - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/number}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

issue_events_url.description: GitHub API template for an issue event - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/number}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

issues_url.description: GitHub API template for an issue - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/number}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

keys_url.description: GitHub API template for a deploy key - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/key_id}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

labels_url.description: GitHub API template for a label - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/name}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

languages_url.description: API URL giving the byte count per language. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

merges_url.description: API URL for creating a merge. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

milestones_url.description: GitHub API template for a milestone - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/number}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

notifications_url.description: GitHub API template for notifications - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{?since,all,participating}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

open_issues.description: Open issue count, e.g. 311. GitHub counts pull requests as issues here, so it is not the number of bug reports.

owner.description: The account that owns the repository, with its login, id, type and URLs. Whether the owner is a User or an Organization changes how permissions work.

private.description: True for a private repository. A token with access returns private repositories from a search, so a result set can mix them with public ones.

pull_request_creation_policy.description: Who may open pull requests, e.g. 'all'.

pulls_url.description: GitHub API template for a pull request - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/number}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

releases_url.description: GitHub API template for a release - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/id}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

score.description: Search relevance score for the hit, e.g. 1.0. Results are ordered by it.

ssh_url.description: SSH git URL, the one that works with a deploy key. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

stargazers_url.description: API URL listing who starred the repository. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

statuses_url.description: GitHub API template for commit statuses - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{sha}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

subscribers_url.description: API URL listing watchers. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

subscription_url.description: API URL for the caller's own watch state. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

svn_url.description: Subversion-compatible URL. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

tags_url.description: API URL listing tags. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

teams_url.description: API URL listing teams with access. A plain URL, unlike the templated *_url fields beside it.

trees_url.description: GitHub API template for a git tree - an RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE ending in '{/sha}', not a URL. Fetched unexpanded it returns 404; the placeholder must be substituted or stripped.

visibility.description: Visibility, e.g. 'public', 'private', 'internal'. Finer than the `private` boolean, which cannot express 'internal'.

watchers.description: GitHub returns the STARGAZER count here, not the number of watchers - 14938 against 241 actual subscribers on the measured repository. Reading it as 'people watching' overstates it by a factor of sixty.

watchers_count.description: The same stargazer count under the other name. Neither field is the watcher count; subscribers_count is.

web_commit_signoff_required.description: True when the repository requires a sign-off on web commits.

name: GitHub_get_repository
description: Get detailed metadata for a specific GitHub public repository. Returns full repository information including description, statistics (stars, forks, watchers, open issues), programming language, topics, license, README existence, and recent activity. Use full_name in owner/repo format (e.g., 'deepmind/alphafold'). Useful for getting repository details for scientific software tools.

name: GitHub_get_user_profile
description: Get a public GitHub user profile by username. Returns user metadata including name, bio, company, location, public repository and gist counts, follower/following counts, and account creation date. No API key required (rate limited to 60 requests/hour unauthenticated). Useful for looking up developer profiles, finding researchers' GitHub activity, and exploring contributors to scientific software projects.

username.description: GitHub username. Examples: 'torvalds' (Linus Torvalds), 'gvanrossum' (Guido van Rossum), 'hadley' (Hadley Wickham), 'jlord' (Jessica Lord)

html_url.description: URL to user's GitHub profile page

events_url.description: GitHub API template for the account's events, e.g. with a '{/...}' placeholder in it. An RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE, not a URL - requesting it unexpanded returns 404.

followers_url.description: API URL listing the account's followers, e.g. 'https://api.github.com/users/torvalds/followers'. A plain URL, unlike several of its siblings.

following_url.description: GitHub API template for who the account follows, e.g. with a '{/...}' placeholder in it. An RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE, not a URL - requesting it unexpanded returns 404.

gists_url.description: GitHub API template for the account's gists, e.g. with a '{/...}' placeholder in it. An RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE, not a URL - requesting it unexpanded returns 404.

gravatar_id.description: Legacy Gravatar hash. Measured NULL - GitHub stopped populating it, so it is a declared always-empty field rather than a dropped one.

node_id.description: The account's GraphQL node id, e.g. 'MDQ6VXNlcjEwMjQwMjU='. Required by the GraphQL API, where the numeric id is not accepted.

organizations_url.description: API URL listing the account's organisations.

received_events_url.description: API URL listing events the account received.

repos_url.description: GitHub API template for the account's repositories, e.g. with a '{/...}' placeholder in it. An RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE, not a URL - requesting it unexpanded returns 404.

site_admin.description: True for a GitHub staff account.

starred_url.description: GitHub API template for repositories the account has starred, e.g. with a '{/...}' placeholder in it. An RFC 6570 URI TEMPLATE, not a URL - requesting it unexpanded returns 404.

subscriptions_url.description: API URL listing the account's watched repositories.

url.description: API URL for the account, e.g. 'https://api.github.com/users/torvalds'. The API address, not the html_url a person would open.

user_view_type.description: How much of the profile this view shows, e.g. 'public'. An authenticated request can see more, so a field missing here may exist.
